title: DECISION: signature verification runs over pre-Path-prepend bytes
description: pipeline.rs snapshots the original article bytes before prepend_path_header() modifies the Path: header, and passes those original bytes to verify_article(). The X-Stoa-Sig is computed by the originating peer over the article as transmitted, before any transit hop modifies headers. Verifying over modified bytes would produce systematic false-negatives for every article that passes through a transit node. The code names this distinction explicitly with a comment.
